notes.title: Update - 1.01
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update - 1.01[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Added[/b][/h2]

- Added a difficulty button to the option menu, when activated increases the chance of arrows coming on your way.

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]

- Highscore List no longer looks like an unstable jenga tower.

- Changed the Sombrero Guy's music from "obvious stock music" to "not so obvious stock music".

[h3][b]Hail to all Raiders out there![/b][/h3]

[h3][b]- Orkbadger (Developer)[/b][/h3]

notes.title: 💰🏹 Run Raiders Run 🏹💰 Demo is Live!
notes.content:
I am exited to write my first blog. I have been working on the game for a while and it will be available for you to try on Steam Next Fest 3 October 2022 in Early Access.

I am humbled by your continuous support from day one.

If you haven’t already heard of it, Non-Stop Raiders is a auto side-scroller game that you play as a raider. Run and jump across platform as you pillage gold from either your enemies or chests across your journey to upgrade abilities or unlock new charecters. 

Use the gold you collected to unlock new abilities like your Shield which protects you from obstacles or attacks. Unlock and use Dash to reach further distances or recollect the speed you lost. Increase your durability to endure even more injuries or you could increase the gold you get from plundering so you can unlock more content quicker.

That's enough for today’s blog, I would like to see all of you on Steam Next Fest. I can’t wait to bring the full version.

Our Discord server is ready here for you to join if you would like to reach us directly.

Don’t forget to add to your wishlist, stay tuned!
